limitations: L4 establishes synthetic software/arithmetic acceptance only, never physical, biological or clinical validity or independent review. No live experiment or CI wiring is added by this pack; the owner retains batch gate integration.
Hashes and declared timestamps cannot prove historical freezing or source authenticity. Rigor classification and independent review remain with the coordinator.

Only Michaelis-Menten, unweighted nonlinear Gauss-Newton, fixed reference units and no exclusions are implemented; substrate inhibition is outside this route. An exploratory model change still requires a separate frozen bundle.

Asymptotic Jacobian standard errors assume an adequate model and fixed known enzyme concentration; enzyme uncertainty is not propagated. Residual sign patterns are diagnostics, not proof of model adequacy.
Positive scientific statuses, including replicated, are refused for a single synthetic fixture; computed agreement and review approval are never positive scientific evidence.

Conservative English case-insensitive whole-word lexical gate with word-character prefix suffixes: caus*, mechanis*, therap*, clinic*, efficac*, effective*, treat*, cure*, prevent*, recommend*, prescri*, bind*, affinit*, inhibit*, activat*, regulat*, drive/drives/driv*, induc*. Extra refusals cover truth, physical validity separated by whitespace or hyphen, diagnos*, patient* and drug*. It is incomplete and refuses negations too.

Unavailable text additionally refuses supported, replicated, suggestive and significan*. Any unavailable kind/result citation requires unavailable status, including mixed support. Both evidence kind and result are checked for review, approv, comput, numer, agreement, truth, physical and clinic.
Expected-fixture and negative-fixture schemas describe test metadata; the CLI does not admit them as scientific records. No existing global schema or stored record class changes.
